component: Manual form AccountConfig assertions and actual custom assert helper

quotes.text: errorMsg || "Programming bug. Assertion failed, see log."

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The two new snapshot assertions call the actual AccountCreationUtils.assert with a condition only. Its second errorMsg argument falls back to a generic NotReached text when absent, so the failure would not identify whether previousConfig or currentConfig should be an AccountConfig. These touched assertions need distinct nonempty expected-behavior messages under the deliberate assertion guidance. The helper/import/export and both calls were read; no assertion failure or runtime result was produced.
title: Automatic-change snapshot guards omit expected-behavior assertion messages
